description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array' that extends 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor'. It provides functionality to map numerical data values to labels using an array, useful for data visualization tasks such as plotting country populations or date mappings.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array
classes.description: A class that formats data by looking up values in an array, enabling mapping of numerical data to labels.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Array
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a lookup array.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Processes a value by returning its mapped label from the array if available, otherwise returns the original value.
